name: owlpost
description: IMAP/SMTP email for iCloud, Gmail, Proton Bridge and any provider: search, read, follow threads, send.
long_description: owlpost is an MCP server for real-world IMAP/SMTP mail. It handles provider quirks (iCloud BODY.PEEK fetches and CRLF APPEND, Gmail X-GM-THRID threads and auto-saved Sent, Proton Bridge STARTTLS with self-signed certs) and auto-discovers folders via SPECIAL-USE. Configure one or more accounts in an accounts.toml file (app passwords, environment variables or a password command).

config_file.title: accounts.toml
config_file.description: Path to your owlpost accounts.toml (see accounts.example.toml in the repository).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the mail accounts configured in owlpost's accounts.toml.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List every IMAP folder (mailbox) in an account.

tools.name: resolve_folder
tools.description: Resolve a special-use role to the provider-specific folder name.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search one folder with structured filters and return message envelopes, newest first.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read one message: decoded headers, body and attachment list, without marking it read.

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Download one attachment from a message and write it to the local filesystem.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Return every message in the same conversation as a given message, oldest first.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email over SMTP immediately; this cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first.

tools.name: save_draft_email
tools.description: Compose an email and save it to the account's Drafts folder without sending it.

tools.name: reply_email
tools.description: Reply to a message and send the reply immediately; confirm with the user first.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.description: Forward a message to new recipients and send it immediately; confirm with the user first.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark a message as read or unread by setting or clearing its \Seen flag.

tools.name: flag_message
tools.description: Flag (star) or unflag a message by setting or clearing its \Flagged flag.

tools.name: move_email
tools.description: Move a message from one folder to another.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Delete a message by moving it to the account's Trash folder.
